question.title: 8086 Assembly String Palindrome Detection
question.prompt: Write an 8086 Assembly Language procedure to verify whether a given $-terminated string in data segment is a palindrome. Use SI and DI index registers with two-pointer comparison. Set AL = 1 if palindrome, AL = 0 otherwise.
question.authorInstructor: Dr. Kazi Tanvir Ahmed (Section B Teacher)
question.solutionNotes: Find string length using SCASB or loop until '$'. Point SI to start, DI to last valid character. Compare [SI] and [DI], advance SI, decrement DI until SI >= DI. Handle single char and empty strings.

sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_a: Prof. Tariq Mahmud: Both CMPSB with Direction Flag manipulation or explicit CMP [SI], [DI] are acceptable.
sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_b: Dr. Kazi Tanvir Ahmed: Requires preservation of altered registers using PUSH/POP standard calling convention.

rubricCriteria.title: Length Calculation & Index Setup
rubricCriteria.description: Correct determination of string length and setting SI to string start and DI to the last character before '$'.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Accurate scanning up to '$', correctly initializes SI and DI without off-by-one errors (1.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Calculates length but includes the '$' delimiter in the comparison or off-by-one (0.5 - 1.0 mark).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Fails to find string boundaries or uses hardcoded string length (0.0 marks).

rubricCriteria.title: Two-Pointer Assembly Comparison Loop
rubricCriteria.description: Comparison loop comparing [SI] with [DI], incrementing SI and decrementing DI, terminating when SI >= DI.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Flawless loop structure, correct byte comparison, proper conditional jumps (JE, JAE, JMP) (2.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Compares bytes correctly but loop termination logic creates an infinite loop or skips middle character (1.0 - 1.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Incorrect memory dereferencing or syntax invalid for 8086 architecture (0.0 marks).

rubricCriteria.title: Output Flag & Register Hygiene
rubricCriteria.description: Properly sets AL = 1 for palindrome, AL = 0 for mismatch, and properly restores registers / RET.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Correct return flags in AL, clean RET instruction, and preserves clobbered registers (1.0 mark).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Sets AL correctly but omits RET or clobbers caller registers (0.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Wrong return register or missing return statement (0.0 marks).

penalties.title: Register Clobbering / Missing PUSH-POP
penalties.description: Modified general registers BX, CX, DX without pushing and popping them.

penalties.title: Off-by-One Delimiter Comparison
penalties.description: Compared the '$' terminator itself instead of actual last character.

sections.name: Section A
sections.teachingNotes: Emphasized string primitive instructions and 8086 addressing modes.

studentScripts.submittedCode:
; 8086 Palindrome Checker - Section A
CHECK_PALINDROME PROC
    PUSH SI
    PUSH DI
    PUSH CX
    
    MOV DI, SI
FIND_LEN:
    CMP BYTE PTR [DI], '$'
    JE  GOT_LEN
    INC DI
    JMP FIND_LEN
GOT_LEN:
    DEC DI              ; Point to last valid char
COMPARE_LOOP:
    CMP SI, DI
    JAE IS_PALIN
    MOV AL, [SI]
    CMP AL, [DI]
    JNE NOT_PALIN
    INC SI
    DEC DI
    JMP COMPARE_LOOP
IS_PALIN:
    MOV AL, 1
    JMP DONE
NOT_PALIN:
    MOV AL, 0
DONE:
    POP CX
    POP DI
    POP SI
    RET
CHECK_PALINDROME ENDP
studentScripts.evaluatorNotes: Exemplary 8086 assembly procedure. Proper register preservation and boundary checks.

sections.name: Section B
sections.teachingNotes: Emphasis on modular programming, interrupts, and memory-mapped IO.

studentScripts.submittedCode:
; Section B - Modular 8086 Assembly
PALINDROME_VERIFY PROC FAR
    PUSH BP
    MOV BP, SP
    PUSH SI
    PUSH DI
    
    MOV SI, [BP+6]       ; String address from stack
    MOV DI, SI
FIND_END:
    CMP BYTE PTR [DI], '$'
    JE  CALC_DONE
    INC DI
    JMP FIND_END
CALC_DONE:
    DEC DI
TEST_LOOP:
    CMP SI, DI
    JGE PALIN_SUCCESS
    MOV AH, [SI]
    CMP AH, [DI]
    JNE PALIN_FAIL
    INC SI
    DEC DI
    JMP TEST_LOOP
PALIN_SUCCESS:
    MOV AL, 1
    JMP CLEANUP
PALIN_FAIL:
    MOV AL, 0
CLEANUP:
    POP DI
    POP SI
    POP BP
    RET 2
PALINDROME_VERIFY ENDP
studentScripts.evaluatorNotes: Used stack parameter passing (BP) and FAR call conventions as taught in Section B. Flawless execution.

breakdown.title: Output Flag & Register Hygiene
breakdown.comment: Proper BP frame restoration with RET 2.

studentScripts.feedbackNote: Superb stack frame usage and clean modular code.

studentScripts.submittedCode:
; Section B Student Submission
CHECK_P PROC
    MOV DI, SI
SCAN_LEN:
    CMP BYTE PTR [DI], '$'
    JE DONE_SCAN
    INC DI
    JMP SCAN_LEN
DONE_SCAN:
    DEC DI
COMP:
    CMP SI, DI
    JA YES
    MOV AL, [SI]
    CMP AL, [DI]
    JNE NO
    INC SI
    DEC DI
    JMP COMP
YES:
    MOV AL, 1
    RET
NO:
    MOV AL, 0
    RET
CHECK_P ENDP
studentScripts.evaluatorNotes: Used JA instead of JAE; single-letter strings or odd-length strings evaluate properly, but omitted stack frame.
